data.title: Growth Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing (m/f/d)
data.description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing you own paid acquisition at Placetel. You bring in the trials and the paying customers that our self-service growth model runs on – with real budget responsibility, across Google, Meta and every channel we have not tested yet.

One thing up front, because it shapes how we work: winning SMB customers in Germany looks far more like winning customers for a DTC brand than like classic enterprise B2B. High volume, short consideration cycles, creative-led, measured daily. That is how we run growth – and that is the mindset we are hiring for.

What you will do

  • Own our paid acquisition budget end to end – strategy, channel mix, allocation and daily optimisation – and be accountable for the outcome.
  • Plan, launch and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta, plus additional channels such as LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, native, affiliate and comparison portals.
  • Manage to unit economics, not vanity metrics: trials, trial-to-paid, CAC, payback period and LTV/CAC are your scoreboard.
  • Build a systematic testing cadence – audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, creative angles – with clear hypotheses, decision rules and documented learnings.
  • Work hand in hand with our Creative Strategist: you brief which angles to test, you read the results, you decide what scales and what dies.
  • Own tracking, attribution and measurement together with our analytics and eCommerce colleagues – GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, conversion values, offline conversion uploads from the CRM.
  • Optimise the full path from ad to trial to paid customer: landing pages, signup flow, offers and pricing tests – together with Growth, Product and Sales.
  • Open up channels we do not run yet and decide quickly whether they earn a permanent budget line.
  • Report performance transparently and in plain language: what worked, what did not, what we do next.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • Several years of hands-on performance marketing with genuine budget responsibility – ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in a DTC or high-velocity consumer brand. Both together is the strongest profile we can imagine for this role.
  • Pro in one channel, solid in the rest. You are the person others ask about Google Ads or Meta, and you can competently run the other channels yourself.
  • You think in unit economics: CAC, payback, LTV/CAC and contribution margin are part of your everyday vocabulary.
  • Confident with tracking, attribution and analytics setups – you fix broken measurement instead of waiting for someone else to.
  • A real creative instinct: you can judge an ad, brief a better one and spot a winning angle before the data fully confirms it.
  • Structured tester: hypothesis, sample size, decision rule, learning written down and shared.
  • Hands-on mentality and high ownership – you make budget calls without needing a committee.
  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs; you need to feel the language they are being sold in.
  • A degree in marketing, business, business informatics or a comparable field – or an equivalent track record that speaks for itself.

Optional and nice to have

  • Experience with free-trial or freemium subscription models and self-service checkout.
  • Experience with comparison portals, affiliate and marketplace channels in Germany.
  • Experience running paid in more than one market or language.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Full ownership of a meaningful acquisition budget and direct, visible impact on growth and revenue.
  • A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
  • A company that is deliberately building a digital, self-service growth model – you will not be fighting the organisation to run modern growth.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
  • Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
  • Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

The Working Student supports the GTM Strategy & Transformation function, working directly with the Senior Director on high-impact strategic and operational priorities. The role contributes to market research, competitive analysis, process improvement, and growth initiatives that directly support the revenue organisation's go-to-market execution. This is a hands-on, project-based role suited to a student with strong analytical foundations, an interest in commercial strategy, and the initiative to take ownership of outcomes rather than just tasks.

  • Support the end-to-end delivery of high-priority GTM initiatives: tracking milestones, managing stakeholder inputs, and ensuring projects deliver measurable outcomes.

data.description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Tasks

Your role

As Creative Strategist you own the single biggest lever in our paid social performance: the creative. Meta is your home channel. You decide what we test, you make sure enough of it exists, and you read the results well enough to know why the winner won.

We are B2B, but we intend to build like a consumer brand. German SMB owners scroll the same feed as everyone else, and they do not stop for a product screenshot with a feature list. Your job is to make them stop – and then to make them start a trial.

What you will do

  • Own the creative engine for paid social – primarily Meta, with TikTok and YouTube as we expand.
  • Turn insight into angles: mine customer reviews, support tickets, sales calls, churn reasons, competitor ads and customer conversations for what German SMBs actually say about their phone system, their calls and their missed business.
  • Build and run a creative testing roadmap: a steady, predictable volume of new concepts every week, structured by angle, format and hook so results are readable rather than anecdotal.
  • Write scripts, hooks and storyboards for short-form video – UGC, founder- and employee-led, testimonial, problem/solution, product demo, static and everything in between.
  • Brief and direct creators, editors, actors and freelancers, run shoots, and manage the production pipeline end to end so throughput never becomes the bottleneck.
  • Analyse creative performance at the right level with the Performance Marketing Manager – hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and trial rate per angle – and decide what to iterate, scale or kill.
  • Maintain a living library of winners, losers and learnings so we compound instead of restarting every quarter.
  • Systematically tear down what works elsewhere – in DTC, in consumer, at other AI and SaaS brands – and transfer the pattern to us.
  • Keep everything on brand and legally clean while still being genuinely entertaining.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • A track record of paid social creative that actually performed at scale, above all on Meta. Bring examples – and the numbers behind them.
  • You think in hooks and in the first three seconds. You can explain why an ad works, not just that it does.
  • You write and judge German copy at native level; solid English on top.
  • Production-capable, not only conceptual: when speed matters you can shoot and cut a usable ad yourself.
  • Comfortable with volume – dozens of variations a month, not three perfect films a quarter.
  • Data-literate: you can navigate Ads Manager reporting and draw your own conclusions without waiting for a dashboard.
  • Strong opinions about creative, loosely held – you let the results decide and you kill your darlings quickly.
  • Agency or in-house experience at a DTC, consumer or high-velocity SaaS brand is a strong plus.

Optional - nice to have

  • Experience building and managing a creator or UGC network.
  • Experience with AI-supported creative production (generative video, voice, image, automated variation).
  • Experience with landing page and post-click creative, not just the ad itself.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Real creative ownership: you set the testing agenda, not an agency.
  • A budget that makes creative testing meaningful and a performance team that will actually read your results.
  • The freedom to build a B2B brand that behaves like a consumer brand – with an AI-native product that gives you something genuinely new to talk about.

data.title: Growth Marketing Manager - Automation (m/f/d)
data.description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Automation you own the automated systems that carry a user from first signup through activation to expansion – and the CRM and AI infrastructure underneath them. Our growth model is self-service and low-touch by design. That only works if the machine behind it is genuinely good.

HubSpot sits at the centre of that machine, connected to product usage data, billing and our web and trial funnel. Your job is to make it do more, do it automatically, and do it with AI agents built natively into the flow – not bolted on as an afterthought.

We are deliberately open on the shape of this role. There are two ways to be excellent at it, and we will build the role around whichever one you bring.

What you will do – the core

  • Own our marketing and sales automation stack, with HubSpot (Marketing + Sales Hub) at the centre and clean connections to product, billing, website and trial funnel.
  • Design, build and continuously improve automated journeys across the whole lifecycle: trial onboarding, activation nudges, lead scoring and routing, upsell and cross-sell, win-back and churn prevention.
  • Replace manual processes with automation – every recurring task a human does today is a candidate, in marketing and in sales.
  • Build AI agents into the funnel natively: qualification, enrichment, routing, response drafting, content generation. Not just AI features inside HubSpot.
  • Keep our data trustworthy: lifecycle stages, attribution and product-usage signals flowing reliably between systems.
  • Measure what you build – every journey has a metric, a baseline and an iteration plan.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Growth Analytics and eCommerce, and make their work easier by removing manual steps from it.

Two possible focus areas – pick yours

You should be strong in one of these and comfortable in the other. Tell us in your application which one is yours.

Focus A – Technical / AI Automation

  • You architect HubSpot rather than just operate it: data model, custom objects and properties, APIs, webhooks, integrations.
  • You build automations beyond HubSpot too – with workflow tools (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with LLM and agent frameworks.
  • You are comfortable with APIs, JSON and enough Python or JavaScript to ship something yourself instead of queueing behind engineering.
  • You have already built working agentic automations, not just prototyped with a chat interface.

Focus B – Lifecycle & Content Automation

  • You own the content inside the journeys: onboarding series, activation emails, in-product messaging, nurture and reactivation tracks.
  • You write German copy that sounds like a person wrote it, not a workflow – and you use AI to produce more of it, faster, without losing that.
  • You design journeys around real user behaviour and know which message at which moment actually moves the metric.
  • You are relentless about testing subject lines, timing, triggers and sequencing.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • Several years in marketing and sales automation, lifecycle marketing, marketing ops or CRM – ideally in B2B SaaS with a self-service or product-led motion.
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, custom properties and objects, lists, lifecycle stages, reporting. You know where its limits are and how to work around them.
  • Clear strength in one of the two focus areas above and solid working knowledge of the other.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI agents and automation – you have already built things with LLMs, not only read about them.
  • Analytical and structured, with a low tolerance for manual, repetitive processes.
  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs and much of the journey content is in German.
  • Self-starter who can carry several topics in parallel and finish them.

Optional - nice to have

  • Experience integrating product usage data into CRM-driven journeys (PQL scoring, usage-based triggers).
  • Experience with data warehouses, reverse ETL or event pipelines.
  • Experience migrating or rebuilding a CRM setup rather than only maintaining one.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A genuinely central role: what you automate defines how our whole growth motion scales.
  • Freedom to choose your tools and to build AI-native rather than retrofitting.
  • A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
  • Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
  • Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

data.title: Finance & Grants Manager
data.description:
We’re building the tools to measure soil carbon at scale. As our Finance & Grants Manager, you’ll secure funding for our research and keep our projects and financial reporting stellar.

About Seqana

Seqana builds digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) of soil carbon. We combine satellite imagery, an extensive proprietary library of soil data, and machine learning to make soil carbon measurement accurate, cost-effective, and scalable.

Regenerative agriculture can store carbon in soils while improving soil health, water quality, food security, and biodiversity. Measuring that impact is often costly and complex. Our tools help project developers, agrifood companies, NGOs, and governments credibly quantify and report the results of regenerative agricultural practices.

We’re based in Berlin, backed by venture capital investors, and supported by public funding from ESA and DLR.

Aufgaben

As our Finance & Grants Manager, you’ll take ownership of public funding at Seqana, from finding the right programmes and writing applications to coordinating funded projects, reporting, and audits. You’ll also own the financial groundwork that keeps project costs traceable and company reporting reliable.

We run a soil carbon MRV project with the European Space Agency and report to EIT and Rentenbank. You’ll build on that work, developing a funding pipeline that fits our research and turning promising opportunities into strong applications.

You’ll report directly to Stefan, our CEO, and work alongside a fractional CFO who owns forecasting and controlling. You’ll work closely with our scientists, engineers, and colleagues in product and commercial roles. Our subject matter experts provide the technical content; you bring the work together, manage deadlines, AI-Powered knowledge banks and take applications and reports through to submission.

You’ll have room to improve how we coordinate projects, prepare our records, and meet our commitments to funders, investors, and the team. Space agencies, European research funding, and soil carbon: it’s an unusual combination, and a good one.

  • Manage our ESA project end to end: monthly progress reports, milestone reviews with our ESA officer, deliverable coordination, time tracking, and cost allocation. Our subject matter experts write the technical content; you own the process, deadlines, and submission.

  • Own EIT reporting, EnHANCE requirements, and funder portals. Coordinate funder audits and keep the supporting records complete and ready for review.

External reporting and corporate affairs

  • Own the reporting calendar and coordinate contributions so submissions are complete and on time.
  • Coordinate shareholder resolutions, and notary appointments.

Financial operations

  • You plan around fixed deadlines and keep submissions accurate and on time.

  • Excellent communication skills in German and English.

Nice to have

  • Background in Drittmittelmanagement, Fördermittelmanagement, or kaufmännische Projektabwicklung, for example at a research institute, university, foundation, or consultancy.

  • Familiarity with DATEV, Lexoffice, Pleo, or comparable tools.
  • Experience in a startup where you’ve built or improved the processes you work with.

Benefits

  • The opportunity to shape a growing company in a role where your work is visible to everyone.
  • Direct collaboration with the CEO and leadership team.
  • Competitive salary and a permanent, full-time contract.

data.description:
We’re building the tools to measure soil carbon at scale. As our People & Operations Manager, you’ll help build a company where people can do good work, grow, and enjoy being part of the team.

**
About Seqana**

Seqana builds digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) of soil carbon. We combine satellite imagery, an extensive proprietary library of soil data, and machine learning to make soil carbon measurement accurate, cost-effective, and scalable.

Regenerative agriculture can store carbon in soils while improving soil health, water quality, food security, and biodiversity. Measuring that impact is often costly and complex. Our tools help project developers, agrifood companies, NGOs, and governments credibly quantify and report the results of regenerative agricultural practices.

We’re based in Berlin, backed by venture capital investors, and supported by public funding from ESA and DLR.

Aufgaben

As our People & Operations Manager, you’ll shape how we hire, support, and develop our team, and own the everyday operations that make Seqana a good place to work. You’ll report directly to Stefan, our CEO, and work closely with the leadership team and everyone across the company.

With a new funding round behind us, we’re developing the structures that will support our next stage of growth. You’ll build on what already works and bring more structure where it helps: an HR system that fits our team, a clear framework for development and progression, and a hiring process that brings the right people on board. You’ll have the space to shape the approach and the responsibility to make it work in practice.

Our team brings together soil scientists, engineers, and people in product and commercial roles, often looking at the same problem from four directions. You’ll help keep that team connected, whether we’re at an offsite or working through an ordinary Tuesday. Together with the leadership team, you’ll shape how we give feedback, support each other, and put our values into practice.

data.description:

Nutze die Chance, Teil unseres wachsenden Teams bei der Homery Living GmbH in Vörstetten zu werden und deine Karriere im strukturierten Umfeld des Unterkunftsmanagements zu gestalten.

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter für unser Operations-Team, die uns dabei unterstützen, das Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement unserer Standorte zu steuern, mit Firmenkunden und Gästen zu kommunizieren und einen reibungslosen Ablauf von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise sicherzustellen.

Wenn du kommunikativ und redegewandt bist, gerne mit Kunden und Gästen arbeitest und gleichzeitig Wert auf klare Prozesse und strukturierte Arbeitsabläufe legst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Über Homery Living GmbH

Die Homery Living GmbH mit Sitz in Vörstetten ist spezialisiert auf das Management und die operative Verwaltung von Monteurunterkünften. Wir bieten umfangreiche Dienstleistungen im Bereich Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement an und zeichnen uns durch klare Prozesse und Strukturen aus.

Unser Ansatz ist es, alle operativen Abläufe direkt vom Büro aus zu steuern. Dazu gehören die Gästekommunikation, die Zusammenarbeit mit Firmenkunden sowie die Organisation der Buchungen, Preisgestaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Kalenderverwaltung, Reinigungskoordination und Problemlösung.

Die Homery Living GmbH verwaltet derzeit über 1.000 Betten an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland und gewährleistet durch bewährte Methoden, dokumentierte Prozesse und klare Strukturen stabile und zuverlässige Dienstleistungen.

Unser Unternehmen steht für Qualität, professionelle Abwicklung und den Anspruch, sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter langfristig verlässliche Strukturen zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team die täglichen Abläufe rund um unsere Monteurunterkünfte. Deine Arbeit findet dabei überwiegend digital und telefonisch von unserem Büro in Vörstetten aus statt.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Bearbeitung und Koordination von Buchungsanfragen
  • Telefonische und schriftliche Kommunikation mit Firmenkunden und Gästen
  • Erstellung und Versand von Angeboten und Rechnungen
  • Preisverhandlungen mit Kunden

  • Koordination von Reinigungen und weiteren operativen Abläufen
  • Bearbeitung und Lösung auftretender Probleme während eines Aufenthalts
  • Abstimmung mit unserem internen Team sowie externen Dienstleistern
  • Sicherstellung eines strukturierten Ablaufs von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise

Qualifikation

Welcher berufliche Hintergrund zu uns passt

Besonders gut passt diese Position zu dir, wenn du bereits Erfahrung in der Hotellerie, im Reservierungsmanagement oder in der Gästebetreuung gesammelt hast.

Geeignete berufliche Hintergründe sind beispielsweise:

  • Hotelfachfrau / Hotelfachmann
  • Kaufmann / Kauffrau für Hotelmanagement
  • Reservierungsmitarbeiter / Reservierungsmitarbeiterin
  • Reservation Agent
  • Front Office Agent
  • Front Office Manager
  • Rezeptionist / Rezeptionistin
  • Empfangsmitarbeiter / Empfangsmitarbeiterin im Hotel
  • Guest Service Agent
  • Mitarbeiter / Mitarbeiterin im Reservierungs- oder Buchungsmanagement

Dabei handelt es sich bei uns nicht um eine klassische Tätigkeit an einer Hotelrezeption. Die operative Betreuung unserer Unterkünfte wird zentral aus unserem Büro gesteuert. Der Kontakt zu Kunden und Gästen erfolgt hauptsächlich telefonisch sowie per E-Mail und WhatsApp.

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Senior Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out.

As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the data layer that stores and serves Camunda 8's process data, spanning relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with an eye toward correctness, performance, and scale.

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, working with Product Management and colleagues across the business to break down requirements into concrete solution designs, driving projects to timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Help evolve how we process, retain, and expose process data, so customers can work with their data the way they need to.

  • Invest in making our secondary storage systems more performant and scalable as usage grows, and build tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate the data layer in production.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. 

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  At least 7 years of experience as a backend engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores

  • Deep experience with both Relational Databases (ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL), and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end — solution design, project planning, coordinating across teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience working with both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

  • Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines.

  • Understanding of database migration tooling (e.g. Liquibase, Flyway) and schema evolution in a live system.
